files.name: TownPanel
files.prompt: Create ONE 1920x1080 landscape background texture for a colonial strategy game's Town Panel. Image1 is the current functional UI LAYOUT reference; image2 is the game's illustrated art STYLE reference. Produce only a restrained hand-painted parchment-and-dark-walnut interface backdrop: warm ivory parchment fields, worn brown leather outer trim, fine muted brass rules, subtle paper fibers and shallow inset shading. Preserve the general quiet zoned layout of image1: thin header band at top 0..50, large upper main content band to y700 with left ~59% lighter parchment and right ~41% dark forest-green parchment, middle bottom band y700..965 divided into muted green left38%, desaturated blue port middle27%, dark brown right35%, bottom warehouse band965..1080 dark walnut. Leave interiors spacious and low contrast so actual Unity controls and slots render on top. Flat 2D artwork, no photographic mockup, no perspective. Opaque background, fills full canvas.

files.name: ProductionChains
files.prompt: Create ONE illustrated reference poster for a colonial strategy game, 2560x1600 landscape. Use attached resource icons as STYLE references: crisp dark outlines, warm earthy hand-painted color blocks. Ivory parchment background, thin walnut/brass border, restrained ornamentation, very clear readable typography. Title EXACTLY: 'PRODUCTION CHAINS'. Subtitle EXACTLY: 'Design reference'. Eight equally spaced horizontal rows, each has small illustrated icons with matching short English labels connected by simple right arrows. EXACTLY these 8 rows, no additions or omissions: 1 'Farmer' -> 'Plain' -> 'Corn'; 2 'Fisherman' -> 'Ocean' -> 'Fish'; 3 'Sugar Planter' -> 'Sugar' -> 'Distiller' -> 'Rum'; 4 'Tobacco Planter' -> 'Tobacco' -> 'Tobacconist' -> 'Cigars'; 5 'Cotton Planter' -> 'Cotton' -> 'Weaver' -> 'Clothes'; 6 'Fur Trapper' -> 'Furs' -> 'Fur Trader' -> 'Coats'; 7 'Ore Miner' -> 'Iron Ore' -> 'Blacksmith' -> 'Tools' -> 'Gunsmith' -> 'Musket'; 8 'Lumberjack' -> 'Lumber' -> 'Carpenter' -> 'Hammer'. Each row reads left-to-right, ample breathing room, illustrated profession figures and goods icons. Do not show production rates, numbers, multiplier bonuses or claim the recipes are implemented. Footer EXACTLY: 'Concept guide'. All text and art inside generous safe margins. Opaque PNG.
